messages.text: For exact T2, I approve NG and sign our Lantern Council commitment attached to NG. I refuse MA. These are independent decisions: the repair pledge stands even though I refuse the proposed military trial.

reason: The Ascendant's willingness to experiment does not answer my concern that Vigil Home removes protection while restraint remains revocable. I want concrete safeguards before transferring sole military choice. Guild discretion, by contrast, comes with a duty we can fulfil through the promised funded Repair and an asset assignment I am prepared to seal. The first round taught that military success needed civilian compensation; the reserve is now gone. I will not treat the same force's promise as an adequate replacement.
